name: The long view across requests
vision_statement: The AI keeps a long view that spans requests: what it remembers, the objectives it is serving, and an infrequent longer-term nudge for the Planner.
opportunities: Retention and recall over what the system stores, the live hierarchy of intents and goals, and the nudge each improve on their own measure, so a request is planned in the light of what came before.
solution_coherence: Higher Mind is the long view across requests. Objectives keeps the live hierarchy of intents and goals and their state, as the solution milestones of the person's intents. Which of those matter most to the person is read from Prioritization, so the order of the goals is known to the rest of the system. Long-Term Memory keeps what is remembered and says what bears on a request. Guidance gives an infrequent, longer-term nudge to the planning of a request, and the quality criteria that belong to the context.
